profile.headline: Software Engineer | ex-Twitter
profile.summary:
With 3+ years of software development experience and 5+ years in personal finance, I am a software engineer who combines technical expertise, analytical skills, and business acumen. I am passionate about creating innovative solutions that leverage data, technology, and design to solve real-world problems and improve user experiences. I enjoy working with diverse and collaborative teams that share a common vision and mission, and I value continuous learning and professional growth.

As a software engineer at Twitter, I contributed to the development, testing, and maintenance of various web applications and features.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Worked on the Code Review team improving Developer Productivity for over 3,500 Twitter engineers at Twitter.

positions.title: Certified Financial Planner
positions.description: Beacon Pointe Advisors is one of the largest independent Registered Investment Advisory firms (RIAs) in the United States working with both private and institutional clients. We are independent and 100% employee-owned. We provide clear, objective investment advice to our clients - our clients' goals and needs are our goals and needs - they are one and the same.
